responsibility: This header declares the public interface to the mc code generator's C/C++ naming and definition-emission subsystem. It exports feature-marking hooks for required headers, macros, runtime helpers, and library symbols; scope enter/leave operations; identifier mangling services that avoid clashes with target-language names; and the procedures that emit required config/system includes and generated support definitions into the output stream.
same_name_distinction: Declares the exported keyc API used by the code generator to mark required support features, manage scopes, mangle identifiers, and emit definitions. Unlike Gkeyc.cc, it provides only the callable interface, not the keyword tables, scope stack, or mangling/emission implementation.
